intent.title: Correct the four explicitly authorized CI failure areas
intent.summary: User selected: Fix the remaining CI failures. The offered scope authorized four new sealed repair tasks, hosted-gate verification, corrected main publication, and affected installation refresh.
success: Write atomically when descriptor chmod is unavailable and close the temporary descriptor before failure cleanup.
Create and read deterministic ZIP bytes through one owned temporary stream without reopening its live pathname.
Preserve the repository operating import in the officially supported .claude/CLAUDE.md location while keeping strict native plugin validation enabled.
Verify identical canonical input and each independently rendered audio artifact rather than require byte-identical output from separate operating-system speech generations.
out_of_scope: No version bump, release-tag publication, unrelated product changes, or weakening of actual artifact-integrity checks.
Native speech synthesis and encoder internals are unchanged. Their hosted variation is not an unresolved architectural dependency of correcting a smoke assertion that exceeds the documented contract.

components: Claude repository memory and native plugin validation
external_dependencies: Local macOS speech, FFmpeg, Poppler, and Chromium
Existing Task-Spec HMAC authority and explicit user approval

evidence.summary: Windows Python 3.11 and 3.12 lack os.fchmod; permission failure occurs before descriptor ownership enters a context and cleanup can mask it with WinError 32.
All Windows matrix versions fail when deterministic_zip reopens a still-open NamedTemporaryFile by pathname. Existing export, archive/restore, and CLI scenarios already expose the defect.

Current strict Claude validation warns that root CLAUDE.md is not loaded as plugin context. The file contains only @OPERATING.md. Official memory documentation supports .claude/CLAUDE.md and resolves imports relative to that file.

Hosted exports share source_script_sha256 9e79a2c9adfd7219dac392d54cf55a486f6f516b22a11ad4053b6df86e547d91 but measure 47.449887 and 47.473107 seconds. docs/delivery.md limits deterministic byte rendering to core ZIP members. Eight controlled local speech generations and three fixed-input encodes were identical; the hosted variation is retained rather than attributed to an unproven internal cause.
